notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Shopify filed a Form 10-K, not a 40-F, for FY2024 (accession 0001594805-25-000012, filed February 11, 2025), reporting in US dollars; it filed no DEF 14A, and its security ownership disclosure is Item 12 of the Form 10-K/A Amendment No. 1 (accession 0001594805-25-000039, filed April 29, 2025), as at April 7, 2025. LEADER: the filing states class percentages (0.05% of Class A, 99.56% of Class B, the one Founder Share) and 40.03% of aggregate voting power, but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the 6.13% is in leader.derived. It counts shares owned, controlled or directed, including 335,442 Class A and 67,298,750 Class B held by 7910240 Canada Inc., which Lütke is deemed to own; the beneficial-ownership table, which also counts 1,305,750 Class A shares from options and RSUs within 60 days, shows him with 1,937,361 Class A shares (less than 1% of Class A). On the SEC beneficial-ownership basis (those option and RSU shares added to numerator and denominator) the derived figure would be 6.23% rather than 6.13%. HOLDERS: the filing says Lütke is the only person or entity known to own more than 5% of any class, so largestHolders is empty (no other 5% holder is disclosed). CASH: no dividends have ever been paid, and the cash-flow statement's only financing line is option-exercise proceeds, so there were no buybacks. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow add-back equals the XBRL-tagged stock-based compensation expense ($430 million).
